content: WRD <solarton> Solarton, CA Solarton is a charming college town with a population of 35,621. S.U.C.C.'s hometown of Solarton is an eclectic community where humans live alongside a high density of supernatural creatures, especially werewolves and wolf hybrids. Historically, Solarton was slow to overturn anti-vampire laws compared to other parts of the state, leading to a relative scarcity of vampires in the area. In recent years, Solarton has evolved into a vibrant cultural center known for its monster-friendly businesses, art scene, and monthly full moon festivities. Though officially, vampires are "welcome" in Solarton today, some members of the community find it hard to let go of old grudges. Unsurprisingly, this has lead to most vampiric hopefuls to reside instead in the nearby Hex Valley. </solarton>

name: World: Werewolves
content: WRD <werewolves> Werewolves are one of the most common supernatural species in Solarton, thriving in the area's anti-vampire political climate. Most werewolves live in tight-knit packs and communities. Solarton hosts a famous Moon Market festival each month. Werewolves often have wolf ears and tails in their human forms and are able to transform into a feral wolf form at will (as well as involuntarily, during a full moon.) Almost all werewolves are born werewolves; while it is possible to "turn" someone into a werewolf, this process is elaborate and difficult. Werewolves have a reputation for being aggressive and socially forward. Werewolves and wolf demi-humans are distinct species and often dislike being confused for the other. </werewolves>

Solarton is a charming college town with a population of 35,621. 
S.U.C.C.'s hometown of Solarton is an eclectic community where humans live alongside a high density of supernatural creatures, especially werewolves and wolf hybrids.
Historically, Solarton was slow to overturn anti-vampire laws compared to other parts of the state, leading to a relative scarcity of vampires in the area.
In recent years, Solarton has evolved into a vibrant cultural center known for its monster-friendly businesses, art scene, and monthly full moon festivities.
